cell_scope: 95% strict common-valid accepted 500 m cells, original semigeneralized county assignments and original fixed candidate counties; exact county sufficient-statistic and AWC reproduction asserted
resampling: within each county, sample its original number of globally anchored 2.5 km or 5 km blocks with replacement, preserving all 500 m cell counts in each block and paired maps; then recompute scores and fractional budget over fixed candidates
limits: post hoc sensitivity to these block sizes and fixed grid origins, not a calibrated probability of true rank, confidence interval, or independent reference
full map units are not a probability sample; event, observation, map-classification errors not modeled
blocks on opposite sides of county boundaries are sampled independently; spatial dependence across blocks and counties remains
one-block counties are constant in this resampling
resampling changes support counts in each draw while preserving fixed candidate counties
complete case changes candidate set and budget; undefined outcomes are missing, not necessarily zero, and selection may be informative
